exposure: accidental pregnancy during tenofovir disoproxil fumarate therapy
cohort: 112 couples with accidental pregnancies during chronic hepatitis B treatment, divided into an observational group (53 couples receiving entecavir, later switched to tenofovir) and a control group (59 couples receiving tenofovir).
finding: Initiating entecavir or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate in early and middle pregnancy appears safe for both mothers and infants, with comparable safety profiles and no significant differences in congenital disabilities observed between groups.
